name: WPAwesom3 Reseller Sync for WooCommerce
author: wpawesom3

sections.description:
WPAwesom3 Reseller Sync for WooCommerce connects two WooCommerce stores: a Seller Store and a Reseller Store.

With this plugin, the seller can share products and the reseller can import and sell them on their own storefront. Sales and commission data are tracked in a built-in ledger so both sides can monitor performance.

Key capabilities:
– Run in Seller mode, Reseller mode, or Both mode.
– Share products from the seller store and import them on reseller stores.
– Keep imported catalog data updated from the seller.
– Support referral-based Buy Now journeys from reseller to seller checkout.
– Track referred sales and commission in a clear ledger view.
– Track page views and clickthroughs with free built-in tracking stats.
– Control which reseller sites can connect using an allowlist.
– Sync products between two WooCommerce stores remotely.

This plugin is ideal for partner selling, multi-store WooCommerce operations, and reseller networks.

How It Works

  1. Configure one store as the seller and another as the reseller.
  2. The seller shares products from WooCommerce.
  3. The reseller imports those products into its catalog.
  4. Orders and referral activity are recorded for commission tracking.
  5. Both stores can review results through the plugin’s reporting views.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Open WPAwesom3 Reseller Sync for WooCommerce under the WordPress admin menu and configure seller URL, API keys, and mode.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin only loads its features when WooCommerce is active.

Can I control which reseller sites are allowed?

Yes. You can define allowed reseller URLs in settings. This helps restrict connections to trusted stores.

Does this support commission tracking?

Yes. The plugin tracks referral sales and commission amounts in the ledger views for seller and reseller workflows.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Added robust Quick Connect authorization status flow between seller and reseller sites with a public status-check endpoint.
  • Improved pending/connected/disconnected state handling on every settings refresh, including revoke and unreachable-seller fail-safe behavior.
  • Added extensive debug events for auth lifecycle tracing and stabilized pending UI rendering with safe fallbacks.
  • Synced seller and reseller logic so both sides handle approval, rejection, and callback states consistently.

1.0.3

  • Added free tracking stats with product page views, clickthrough tracking, and conversion insights.
  • Added Tracking Stats admin screen with top products and top reseller sites by clicks.
  • Updated plugin naming in readme to WPAwesom3 branding.

1.0.2

  • Improved integration stability and initialization flow.
  • Updated plugin assets and packaging for directory release.
  • Minor compatibility and maintenance refinements.

1.0.1

  • Rename and slug-alignment updates for plugin review.
  • Replaced inline CSS/JS outputs with proper enqueue usage.
  • Hardened request handling with nonce and capability checks.
  • Added WooCommerce dependency header and documentation cleanup.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
